strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Hidden File System Abuse

analytics.name: Analytic 1271
analytics.guidance: Anomalous creation or mounting of hidden partitions or virtual file systems. Defender view: detection of registry modifications linked to non-standard file systems, suspicious disk I/O patterns, or bootkit-like behavior where hidden volumes are accessed outside normal file system APIs.

tuning.description: Specify registry paths for mount points and hidden partition configs.
Tune thresholds for raw disk access outside expected drivers.
Correlate boot-time anomalies with hidden file system mounting activity.

log_sources.name: etw:Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Storage
log_sources.channel: Raw disk I/O operations bypassing NTFS APIs

analytics.name: Analytic 1272
analytics.guidance: Unusual mounting of loopback or pseudo file systems not aligned with legitimate administrative activity. Defender view: monitoring auditd and syslog for mount commands involving suspicious mount points, reserved blocks, or device mappings indicative of hidden partitions.

tuning.description: Whitelist standard mount points to reduce false positives.
Flag root escalation during mount operations.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: mount or losetup commands creating hidden or encrypted FS

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Sudo or root escalation followed by filesystem mount commands

analytics.name: Analytic 1273
analytics.guidance: Hidden file system use through APFS containers or custom plist configuration. Defender view: anomalous use of hdiutil or diskutil to attach hidden partitions, modification of plist entries tied to system volumes, or suspicious raw disk access.

tuning.description: Adjust to target only relevant plist files linked to volume mounting.
Restrict monitoring to sensitive processes like diskutil and hdiutil.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Execution of diskutil or hdiutil attaching hidden partitions

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Hidden volume attachment or modification events
